The rule in plain words: We ask TikTok for the newest videos about each competitor, not the most popular ones
What happened: All of them come in at this point. Nothing is judged yet.
Why the rule exists: If we asked for popular videos we would only ever see things that already blew up last week.

The rule in plain words: The caption or hashtags have to actually say the competitor's name
The numbers: 612,131 views. A ghost story. Found by the search 'speak app'.
What happened: THROWN OUT. Big video, nothing to do with us.
Why the rule exists: TikTok search is loose. It gives you anything that sounds vaguely similar.

The rule in plain words: Same rule, another example
The numbers: 595,797 views. A Vietnamese singing video. Found by 'linguza english tutor'.
Why the rule exists: Proof the filter is doing real work. 455 of 507 videos died here today.

The rule in plain words: Same rule, another example
The numbers: 449,889 views. A Turkish football press conference. Found by 'falou'.
Why the rule exists: 'Falou' means 'spoke' in Portuguese, so the search drags in anything.

The rule in plain words: A video that PASSES the rule
The numbers: 18,836 views. Caption says 'La app que uso se llama praktika'.
Why the rule exists: This is what we are actually looking for: a real person talking about a competitor's app.

The rule in plain words: We match whole words, not pieces of words
The numbers: Malay post tagged #TamatPraktikal, which means 'internship finished'.
What happened: THROWN OUT (used to be kept by mistake).
Why the rule exists: 'Praktika' sits inside the Malay word 'praktikal'. Short brand names crash into ordinary foreign words all the time.

The rule in plain words: Same bug, a car advert
The numbers: A Perodua car advert using the Malay word 'praktikal'.
What happened: THROWN OUT (used to be kept by mistake).
Why the rule exists: Was landing on the Praktika list every single day until this was fixed.

The rule in plain words: If the company posts on its own account we ignore it
The numbers: 2,600,000 views, posted by ELSA Speak's own account.
What happened: THROWN OUT despite being the biggest video we saw.
Why the rule exists: That is just ELSA advertising. It tells us nothing about whether something is spreading on its own.

The rule in plain words: Videos longer than 2 minutes are dropped
The numbers: 8 minutes long. A Loora app review.
Why the rule exists: An 8 minute review is not short form creative. We would never rebuild it as an ad.

The rule in plain words: Is TikTok handing it to bigger and bigger audiences. Worth 22%
What happened: Could not be calculated for any video today.
Why the rule exists: You need several measurements hours apart. The 30 minute job supplies them. It was broken until today, which is why this column is empty.

The rule in plain words: Views compared to what a normal video has by the same age. Worth 20%
The numbers: 137,876 views at 41 hours old. Normal is about 1,000 by then.
What happened: 140 times normal. Highest of the day.
Why the rule exists: 20,000 views is boring after a week and amazing after two hours. Age is the whole point.

The rule in plain words: The opposite case
Why the rule exists: Four days old and still tiny. Nothing is happening here.

The rule in plain words: Is it growing faster than it was. Worth 18%
What happened: Skipped, and the other signals were re-weighted to fill the gap.
Why the rule exists: We never score a missing signal as zero. That would punish a video for being new, which is backwards.

The rule in plain words: Shares, saves, comments and likes. Worth 15%
The numbers: 2,429 shares on 137,876 views. That is 1.76 people in every 100.
What happened: Rated GOOD. The only video today above 1 in 100.
Why the rule exists: A like means 'I enjoyed that'. A share means 'someone else needs to see this'. Only one of those tells you the idea travels.

The rule in plain words: A video with lots of views but nobody sharing
The numbers: 56,244 views but only 17 shares. That is 0.03 in every 100.
Why the rule exists: People watched it. Almost nobody passed it on. Good to know Praktika is spending, weak as an idea to copy.

The rule in plain words: Views compared to what this person usually gets. Worth 15%
The numbers: 3,966 views from an account with 17 followers.
Why the rule exists: It escaped her own audience completely. That is what going viral actually means.

The rule in plain words: Plain views per day. Worth only 5%
Why the rule exists: By the time raw speed looks impressive the video has already peaked. It is the slowest signal to react.

The rule in plain words: A small nudge for newer videos. Worth 5%
Why the rule exists: Tiebreaker only. Halves every 36 hours.

The rule in plain words: 200,000+ views in the first 24 hours
Why the rule exists: This is rare. Most days will have none.

The rule in plain words: 50,000+ views in the first 24 hours
Why the rule exists: Big and fast. Worth a look even though the share rate was weak.

The rule in plain words: 10,000+ views in the first 24 hours
Why the rule exists: Doing well for its age but not yet unusual.

The rule in plain words: Anything else under 24 hours old
Why the rule exists: Too new to judge. Check again in a few hours.

The rule in plain words: Anything else under 48 hours old
Why the rule exists: Had a full day already, so check it is still moving before spending time on it.

The rule in plain words: Past 72 hours it is no longer a candidate
What happened: 6 videos today. Scored low and pushed down.
Why the rule exists: The takeoff window has closed. Whatever it was going to do, it did.

The rule in plain words: Score cut to a quarter above 500,000 views and 2 days old
What happened: Would be cut to a quarter (it was also removed as a brand post).
Why the rule exists: Everyone has seen it. The copies already shipped. You would be reading the news, not breaking it.

The rule in plain words: 25% boost when a small account suddenly gets big numbers
Why the rule exists: When a tiny account gets huge numbers it is almost always the content doing the work, not the audience. That is the shape worth copying.

The rule in plain words: Score 35 or more, under 2 days old
Why the rule exists: Worth attention. Most of the list sits here.

The rule in plain words: Everything else
What happened: Went to the sheet, not the morning list.
Why the rule exists: Nothing wrong with it. Just nothing happening.

The rule in plain words: Below 30 it goes in the sheet but not the morning list
The numbers: Score 30.41. The lowest video that made the list.
Why the rule exists: Just above the line. The one at 29.5 missed it by a point.

The rule in plain words: One brand cannot take over the morning
What happened: Only the best 6 could appear on the morning list.
Why the rule exists: Otherwise a brand running 17 seeded creators would fill your whole screen and hide everyone else.

The rule in plain words: One person cannot take over either
The numbers: 3 videos from this one account today.
What happened: All 3 allowed. A 4th would have been cut.
Why the rule exists: Stops one busy creator crowding out the rest.

The rule in plain words: Score over 35 and under 3 days old gets re-measured every 30 minutes
Why the rule exists: This is the only way to see whether TikTok is pushing it to new audiences, which is the biggest signal we have.

The rule in plain words: How long people watched
The numbers: Not published by TikTok for videos you do not own.
Why the rule exists: Only the account owner can see it. Anyone selling you a competitor's watch time is guessing.

The rule in plain words: What competitors spend on ads
The numbers: Meta publishes no spend or impressions for US commercial ads.
What happened: Ads are judged on how long they have run and how many versions exist.
Why the rule exists: Advertisers kill losing ads fast. An ad still running after 3 weeks is being paid for because it works.

The rule in plain words: A search that failed is labelled, never counted as nothing found
Why the rule exists: 'We looked and found nothing' and 'we never looked' are completely different answers. Mixing them up would hide a competitor going viral.
